keySentence: She dropped her ball into the well and cried.

facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The ball fell in the well. She could not get it. She cried and cried. She dropped her ball into the well and cried.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: The princess could not stop crying by the well. She dropped her ball into the well and cried for a long time. The well was dark and there was no way to reach the bottom. She felt helpless and alone in the garden. Then she heard a tiny splash from inside the well. Someone was about to come and help her.
